title: Questions, <gradient>answered.</gradient>
lede: Everything you need to know about how ClutchD works before you book.

items.question: How does ClutchD matching work?
items.answer: ClutchD finds verified nearby providers for your request, and you can track the match in real time.

items.question: How do estimates and pricing work?
items.answer: You see the price before work starts and approve the estimate before the wrench lifts.

items.question: How are providers verified?
items.answer: Every mechanic and garage passes identity and skill verification (KYC) before joining the network.

items.question: Where is ClutchD available?
items.answer: Currently rolling out in Coimbatore, with more cities planned.

items.question: What payment methods are supported?
items.answer: Pay securely through the platform with Stripe and Razorpay.

items.question: What does "Preview" mean?
items.answer: Some screens and figures on this page are illustrative previews of the product; real numbers update as ClutchD rolls out.
